column4: University of Florida Gainesville is currently enrolling cats with histopathology-confirmed oral SCC and staging; advanced local or metastatic disease and major systemic illness exclude. RNA nanoparticle immunotherapy is added to eligible standard care rather than substituting for it. Three vaccine visits, study monitoring, 1- and 3-month rechecks and any booster administration covered; screening and routine treatment remain owner costs. Official oncology study interest route; no calendar cutoff printed.

University of Florida Gainesville explicitly recruiting canine recently diagnosed resectable or minimal oral melanoma before whole-tumor excision. Four GD2/3 vaccines and four IV gilvetmab doses; tissue sampling and follow-up. The study pays gilvetmab and study biopsies; owners pay vaccination, screening and follow-up care. UF Oncology phone and required veterinarian referral route printed; no calendar cutoff.

Virginia Tech design requires an operable canine thyroid tumor, stable anesthesia candidate and owner election of surgery. Histotripsy is performed one day before resection, not an alternative to surgery in this protocol. MRI and histotripsy covered. The main compensation paragraph gives a $3,000 resection credit, but adjacent compassionate-fund note references $2,000. No new award amount or clinical/funding date asserted until actual authoritative clarification.

Tufts Grafton explicitly recruiting. Group A appendicular treatment-naive OSA with no obvious metastasis, >=15 kg, planned amputation; drug before and after surgery replaces carboplatin. Group B after amputation and carboplatin or study therapy with specified nonbone metastasis. Olaparib, temozolomide or VLS-1488; testing and post-amputation study treatment covered, $1,500 amputation credit for A, unrelated care excluded. Published clinical trials office and owner/referral prescreen. No calendar cutoff stated.

Tufts Grafton recruiting a single SABR fraction for confirmed canine malignancy with 2–10 progressive lung nodules, controlled primary, appropriate control of nonpulmonary disease and safely treatable targets. A distinct cohort from primary lung carcinoma SBRT. Pays SABR and one-month/related toxicity checks and up to $860 for 2–3 month CT; owners pay pre-enrollment diagnostics and planning imaging. Public clinic and prescreen contact; no published calendar cutoff.

Tufts Grafton recruiting pathologically/cytologically confirmed single primary canine lung carcinoma >1 cm in shortest diameter, no prior target treatment, regional node metastasis or metastatic pulmonary disease. Dogs with other recent active malignancy excluded subject to documented historical-remission exception. SBRT; study up to $4,000 for planning/anesthesia/treatment, up to $1,000 may cover follow-up radiographs. Prescreen/complication hospital costs owner-paid. Clinic office published; no calendar cutoff.

Exact Illinois Urbana funded protocol: treatment-naive histology/cytology diagnosed multicentric peripheral-node lymphoma; minimum 1 year and 4 kg, no indolent/small-cell disease, clinical organ/function screening. No systemic prior steroid or chemotherapy; source explicitly allows steroid-containing topicals. IV daunomustine up to five doses, possible L-asparaginase rescue. Study funded after qualification; owner pays initial diagnostics and unrelated care, some adverse-event costs eligible with limits. Named trials coordinator; no exact calendar cutoff.

Exact Illinois Urbana PDF on current master: canine confirmed alkaline-phosphatase-positive appendicular osteosarcoma strictly age >1, weight >=5 kg, no chest/abdominal metastasis, no prior radiation, chemo or immunotherapy, specified immunomodulator washouts, fitness for sedation/anesthesia. Three consecutive SBRT days, then injection of hydrogel near tumor. Study therapy, planning CT, biopsy, exams/labs funded after eligibility; screening and pain medication owner-paid. Named intake team. No exact recruitment cutoff.

Familiar sponsor gives exact FAM-010 at University of Illinois Urbana, post-splenectomy first dose within 21 days, study pays screening, treatment and follow-up; owner pays travel. One dose-escalation intervention with repeated three-week dosing and no placebo. Pathology may be pending at inquiry but must confirm before enrollment; no past chemo/radiation/study drug. Current sponsor page still has placeholder study contact and sequential groups may pause; no renewed cohort slot independently attested.

BARC Edmonds official direct study section explicitly active. Canine superficial MCT >2cm, STS <2cm, oral melanoma 2–3cm or cutaneous/footpad melanoma <2cm; feline oral SCC without bone invasion or cutaneous tumors listed. IV particles then local laser heat; named intake phone. The full cost split and calendar end are not published. Match remains screening-dependent for size and site.

OVC's actual oncology page lists a distinct active feline oral SCC Porphysome phototherapy cohort in Guelph. It gives owner entry and inclusion criteria, but not a current owner-cost breakdown; don't infer full funding from a registry end date. Exact registry roster and uptake pursued separately.
